housing: Most London renters live in flats: Victorian and Edwardian houses converted into flats, purpose-built blocks and council-built estates, with a growing number of new-build towers. Shared houses (HMOs) are common.

tenantHelp.name: Shelter
tenantHelp.what: housing charity with free advice for renters in England

climate: Photograph walls and window frames for damp and mould, especially in bathrooms and ground-floor or basement flats, and run the heating and hot water at move-in.
fact: Many London boroughs require a licence for most private rented homes, so a tenant can check the council's public register before moving in.
